purpose: Drives a session past the context threshold with seeded work, checks the handover is written before the prompt, and checks the seeded work is recovered after /clear.
title: Handover saved before the /clear prompt; work recovered after /clear

testCases.description: The handover note is asked for at 70% context or the second compaction, and saved before the /clear prompt
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/handover-note.test.js::at 70% context or after the second compaction Squire asks for the handover note to be saved, and asks the owner for /clear only once it is saved

testCases.description: After /clear the work in progress is picked up from the handover note
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/handover-note.test.js::after /clear the new conversation picks up the work in progress from the handover note

testCases.description: One conversation's context never brings the handover ask into another; the plan's windows stay the account's
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/handover-per-session.test.js::one conversation's context reading never brings the handover ask into another running beside it, while the plan's windows are the account's in every conversation

testCases.description: After the newest note is picked up, a later /clear never brings an older note as the last conversation's
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/handover-per-session.test.js::after the newest handover note is picked up, a later /clear never brings an older note as the handover from the last conversation

testCases.description: With no usage windows in the status line, a conversation at 76% context is asked for its handover note
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/handover-per-session.test.js::a conversation whose status line carries no usage windows still gets the handover ask on its next message once its own context reaches 76%
